snippet.title: Pinball Heroes - PlayStation Portable Gameplay [PlayStation 4 Re-Release]
snippet.description:
Pinball Heroes got a re-release on the PlayStation 4 and 5 as part of the PlayStation Classics line on PS+ Premium. You can also buy the game separately if you don't have a PS+ Premium subscription. This re-release features trophy support (both PS4 and PS5 have separate trophy lists), remote play, save states and a rewind mode. The tables featured are based on the following PlayStation games from the PS3 era: PAIN, Uncharted: Drake's Fortune, wipEout HD Fury, High Velocity Bowling, Fat Princess, Everybody's Golf / Hot Shots Golf, ModNation Racers and MotorStorm.

Pinball Heroes (C) Sony Interactive Entertainment
